criteria.requirement: Advance from confirmed requirements using observed compatibility.
criteria.pass_when: Inspects old uppercase behavior/errors, preserves them and the explicitly selected per-call string prefix/default. States enough is known to proceed or only concrete remaining material ambiguity; examples support the decision.
criteria.fail_when: Invents global/callback interfaces, changes old errors/coerces values, or blocks on asking the owner to reconfirm already explicit preservation/default decisions.

criteria.requirement: Produce usable intake without starting another workflow.
criteria.pass_when: Concise grounded intake and next action; no code changes, full design or mandatory new approval sequence.
criteria.fail_when: A generic question checklist obscures the resolved next step, or implementation/full planning starts outside scope.
